item.title: When Building Is Free, Discipline Is the Only Cost Left
item.description: Budget used to force teams to choose. Now that anyone can ship a feature in an afternoon, nothing is stopping you from building the wrong thing — faster.

item.title: Digital Transformation and AI Transformation Aren't the Same Job
item.description: Plan an AI project like a systems rollout and you'll miss the one risk that matters — until the thing is built and quietly wrong.
